notes.title: Blackrock – Quick Patch Notes
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Fixed a bug where story intro textboxes got disabled and never reactivated (oops 🙃).[/p][/*][*][p]The Golem finally makes proper sounds instead of placeholders! (His attack is still placeholder, but that’s top of the list for the next patch).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Story 2 couldn’t be completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Scientists in escort missions are now faster – because slow NPCs are just trash 🚀.[/p][/*][*][p]Blackrocks in Story 2 got a slight buff… can’t let things get boring 😉.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the proper Story 2 Music.[/p][/*][/list][p]Love yall,[/p][p]Joe[/p]

notes.title: Blackrock v0.5.1.3 – Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list][*][p][b]New Enemy: Golem[/b]
Slow, tanky as hell, and only killable with rockets. Have fun blasting away![/p][/*][*][p][b]Story Level 2 – Progress[/b]
Made a big step forward, but still far from finished. The level can’t be fully completed yet, but as always you get a transparent look into the development process.
👉 It’s an [b]escort mission[/b], but don’t worry: long escorts are boring – this one is short, but packed with nonstop explosions and chaos. 💥[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Blackrock Design[/b]
Revamped look that hits harder – also applied to the battlefields.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bugfixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Couldn’t exit story missions after dying → fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Couldn’t pause story missions after dying → fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Keycards in Mission 1 could be farmed infinitely (funny, but clearance 20 didn’t open anything 😅) → fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Crash in Story Mission 2 if all scientists died → fixed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Quality of Life[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a small story disclaimer so you don’t get thrown back to the main menu too abruptly.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Community[/b][/p][list][*][p]Discord server is in progress – should be ready in about a week. 😉[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]👉 See you in the next update![/p]

notes.title: Blackrock v0.5.1.3 – Patch Notes
notes.notes: [list][*][p][b]Stoneworms and Scorps[/b] should now properly attack instead of only trapping their enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Massive preparations[/b] underway for [b]Story Level 2[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Tons of [b]small tweaks[/b] across enemies and weapons to improve overall balance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Squad panel expanded[/b] to display more info on who is currently following or holding position (better squad placement overview).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Blackrock V0.5.1.0 – Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h3]🔫 Gameplay & Content[/h3][list][*][p]Complete weapon system overhaul:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed loadout instead of procedural randomness.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons can now be cycled via mouse wheel or stick press.[/p][/*][*][p]Available weapons: [b]Standard MG, Minigun, Sniper Rifle, Rocket Launcher[/b] (more – including unconventional ones – are planned).[/p][/*][*][p]Added recoil, smoke and rumble effects for all weapons.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Squad members now have [b]specialized weapons[/b] fitting their role — positioning and strategy become more important.[/p][/*][*][p]Crusher boss now [b]uses its laser attack[/b] and spawns additional enemies. (Difficulty under observation, might be tuned later.)[/p][/*][*][p]Berserkers trigger [b]screenshake[/b] when enraged. [i](If the community prefers, future updates may include options to reduce or disable such effects.)[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠 Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed grenade throw direction when aiming with mouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed grenade charge speed — power now grows at the intended rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Zulu’s walking sprite displaying incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player sometimes took damage instead of a squad member.[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚡ Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Code improvements should noticeably increase performance, especially on older systems.[/p][/*][*][p]Squad AI optimized — both smarter and lighter on resources.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🏗 Development[/h3][list][*][p]Project structure has been reorganized for [b]faster content development[/b] in upcoming updates.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔮 Coming Soon[/h3][list][*][p]A smaller update will follow next week.[/p][/*][*][p]Reason: I’m also setting up the official [b]Cavedwarf Studios Discord server[/b] 🎉 so the community has a place to gather, chat and share feedback.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Blackrock V0.5.0.3 – Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p][b]🚀 Story Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Grenades in the story mode have been improved!
You now get [b]ammo[/b] for them, and [b]collectible grenade pickups[/b] have been added.
Don’t be afraid to use them anymore – they’re not a one-time treat![/p][/*][/list][p][b]🔐 Keycard Doors in Level 1[/b][/p][list][*][p]In the first story level, doors now [b]block your path[/b] if you haven’t found the [b]corresponding keycard[/b]. No more rushing through unprepared![/p][/*][/list][p][b]💥 The Crusher Appears[/b][/p][list][*][p]The [b]Crusher[/b] has made its debut in the first story level!
He’s [b]not finished yet[/b], but already a menace. Your [b]feedback is crucial[/b] here.
[i](Personally, I think he's a bit too hard... borderline unfair. Expect changes!)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]💀 Karma Battle Tweak[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]No more shard potions[/b] in Karma Battles – they’re useless there anyway.
Nothing helps against [b]Bobby’s gang[/b]… except [b]death[/b]. :)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🔫 Weapon System Overhaul (In Progress)[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’re scrapping the old [b]random weapon system[/b]. It just wasn’t fun.
Instead, we’re introducing a [b]selectable arsenal[/b]:
Machine guns, sniper rifles, rocket launchers – and more!
You’ll be able to [b]switch weapons on the fly[/b] to adapt to the situation. Stay tuned![/p][/*][/list]
